title: SRAP Assertion Schema
description: Safety Relevance Assertion Profile - metadata schema for CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM components

safety_relevance_class.description: SR-0: no safety function | SR-1: indirect | SR-2: supporting | SR-3: direct safety-critical

domain.description: Primary safety domain for this component

asil_mapping.description: ISO 26262 ASIL level (or equivalent for other standards)

safety_analysis_ref.description: Reference URI to FMEA, FTA, HAZOP, or equivalent safety analysis document

component_owner.description: Team or individual responsible for safety disposition of this component

assertion_rationale.description: Human-readable rationale for the safety relevance classification
